sections.introduction: Ajeernakantaka ras is a classical formulation which is the best Ayurvedic remedy for indigestion related conditions. The ingredients of this tablet are very much beneficial in boosting up the digestive fire and having analgesic, antipyretic, anti-inflammatory and digestion stimulant properties.
sections.ingredients:
Shuddha Parada – 1 part 
 Shuddha Gandhak – 1 part 
 Shuddha Vatsnabha – 1 part

sections.description_of_ingredients:
Shuddha Vatsnabha (Purified Aconitum ferox ) is having properties of antipyretic and indigestion, anorexia and other spleen related disorders. 
 Maricha Churna (Powdered form of Piper nigrum ) is used for the treatment of cough, cold, hoarseness of voice and is the best digestive stimulant. 
 Shuddha Parada (Detoxified form of mercury) is the prime constituent of various herbomineral formulations in Ayurveda, it has the micro fined nature that allows it and other ingredients that are mixed in it to easily cross the cell membrane and thus help in quick medicinal action. It is used to relieve the symptoms of belching, bloating, discomfort in stomach etc. 
 Shuddha Gandhak (Purified form of sulphur) is very much useful in various skin disorders. It has the ability of blood purification. It is used for relieving excess gas and providing an immediate relief in various abdominal pain conditions. 

 Bhavna Dravya 
 Kantakari swaras (liquid extract obtained from the fruit of Solanum xanthocarpum ). 
 Method of Preparation 
 Mix the parada and gandhak to make a kajjali from it, then mix vatsnabha and maricha churna in it and give it a well-mixed with the kantakari swaras. Then make 125 mg tablets from the mixture and let the tablets dry in a shady area, and then preserve in a glass tumbler. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 The formulation is best known for its effects on indigestion. It is texeted in the ancient books that after consuming this tablet continuously for a few days, once can be free from all indigestion related ailments. Any symptoms related to indigestion can be treated with this medicine such as bloating, heartburn, hyperacidity, pain in abdomen, sour belching, nausea. This tablet is also beneficial in balancing tridosha and it is also being indicated for visuchika (cholera like condition).

Ajeernakantaka Ras 
 Reference – Bhaisajya Ratnavali Agnimandyadirogadhikar 346/107-108 
 Introduction 
 Ajeernakantaka ras is a classical formulation which is the best Ayurvedic remedy for indigestion related conditions. The ingredients of this tablet are very much beneficial in boosting up the digestive fire and having analgesic, antipyretic, anti-inflammatory and digestion stimulant properties. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Shuddha Parada – 1 part 
 Shuddha Gandhak – 1 part 
 Shuddha Vatsnabha – 1 part 
 Maricha – 3 parts 
 
 Description of Ingredients 
 
 Shuddha Vatsnabha (Purified Aconitum ferox ) is having properties of antipyretic and indigestion, anorexia and other spleen related disorders. 
 Maricha Churna (Powdered form of Piper nigrum ) is used for the treatment of cough, cold, hoarseness of voice and is the best digestive stimulant. 
 Shuddha Parada (Detoxified form of mercury) is the prime constituent of various herbomineral formulations in Ayurveda, it has the micro fined nature that allows it and other ingredients that are mixed in it to easily cross the cell membrane and thus help in quick medicinal action. It is used to relieve the symptoms of belching, bloating, discomfort in stomach etc. 
 Shuddha Gandhak (Purified form of sulphur) is very much useful in various skin disorders. It has the ability of blood purification. It is used for relieving excess gas and providing an immediate relief in various abdominal pain conditions. 
 
 Bhavna Dravya 
 Kantakari swaras (liquid extract obtained from the fruit of Solanum xanthocarpum ). 
 Method of Preparation 
 Mix the parada and gandhak to make a kajjali from it, then mix vatsnabha and maricha churna in it and give it a well-mixed with the kantakari swaras. Then make 125 mg tablets from the mixture and let the tablets dry in a shady area, and then preserve in a glass tumbler. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 The formulation is best known for its effects on indigestion. Any symptoms related to indigestion can be treated with this medicine such as bloating, heartburn, hyperacidity, pain in abdomen, sour belching, nausea. This tablet is also beneficial in balancing tridosha and it is also being indicated for visuchika (cholera like condition). 
 Indications 
 
 Ajeerna – Various indigestion related disorders. 
 Visuchika – Cholera 
 Agnimandya – Weak digestive power 
 Abdominal pain 
 
 Dosage 
 1 tablet twice daily with lukewarm water after meals. 
 Contraindications 
 Not to be used on children below 3 years age or pregnancy conditions. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
